subject.title: refactor(canvas): promote inline-widget hosting and show_widget to core

question: Should generic inline-widget hosting become a core-owned surface while retaining `tools.deny: ["canvas"]` as the compatibility policy for `show_widget`?
rationale: The proposed ownership move is groundwork for a future core dashboard and changes the policy boundary between a bundled plugin and core; code review cannot decide that product and compatibility contract alone.

options.title: Sponsor core ownership with compatibility preservation
options.body: Keep the promotion, restore the Canvas deny-group mapping for `show_widget`, and require focused upgrade proof before merge.

options.title: Keep widget hosting plugin-owned
options.body: Reject the ownership promotion and retain the existing Canvas plugin tool and policy boundary until a broader core dashboard design is approved.

recommendation.title: Sponsor core ownership with compatibility preservation
recommendation.body: Keep the promotion, restore the Canvas deny-group mapping for `show_widget`, and require focused upgrade proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Authored the promotion and is the best available routing candidate in the supplied history.
